name: Does LVP flooring come with a warranty, and what does it cover?

mainEntity.name: Does LVP flooring come with a warranty, and what does it cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most luxury vinyl plank flooring products come with manufacturer warranties that cover defects in material and wear. Residential warranties can range from 15 years to a lifetime, while commercial warranties are typically shorter. Coverage often includes resistance to wear-through, fading, and staining. However, these warranties usually require professional installation and adherence to specific maintenance guidelines. Understanding the warranty terms is a key decision factor, as it protects your investment against manufacturing flaws, but not against improper installation or neglect. Hometelligent Inc. ensures installations meet warranty specifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: LVP typically has manufacturer warranties covering material defects and wear; coverage depends on adherence to installation and maintenance guidelines.
